ordinary_modes_1_through_5.status: The existing tessellated class-10 mesh geometry is sufficient to generate the recovered planar/spherical/cylindrical projections for these bindings.

important_provenance_rule: bz2_hrc_gltf_parametric.py emits TEXCOORD_0 with mesh.extras.uv_source='normalized_parameter_space'. That layer is a reconstruction aid for the NURBS surface parameter domain, not recovered source texture-projection data. It must not be treated as authored Material.CurrentUV merely because it is nonzero.
production_policy: For tessellated NURBS meshes whose glTF mesh extras report uv_source=normalized_parameter_space, code401 modes1..5 should generate the texture projection from tessellated geometry rather than preserve the placeholder TEXCOORD_0.
Model-local code400 modes1..5 already operate on tessellated geometry through the common Blender projection stage.
Code6 and code8 remain outside the ordinary 1..5 generator and require their own projection semantics.
The sole non-unit TXMP matrix scale in the archive is relation400 code1 on a class10/NURBS model and remains deferred until scale direction is independently proven.
